description: Lärmimmissionen Strassen- und Eisenbahnverkehr is a series of datasets listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Umwelt BAFU. Dieser Datensatz enthält die Lärmbelastung pro Gebäude für Strassen- und Eisenbahnlärm im Jahr 2021. Pro Gebäude ist jeweils die höchste an der Fassade auftretende Lärmbelastung (Leq) für verschiedene Beurteilungszeiträume (Tag, Abend, Nacht, Day-Evening-Night, Day-Night) hinterlegt. Ausserdem sind die 2D-Gebäudegrundrisse enthalten, die mit Informationen (u.a. Coverage: Switzerland. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Bundesamt für Umwelt BAFU. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
